mentions.name: Fluir
mentions.description: This web app helps Spanish learners progress beyond the A2 plateau. It generates level-pitched Spanish short stories using Claude, narrated with ElevenLabs; every highlighted word or phrase becomes a spaced-repetition flashcard; and users can practice turn-based conversation with an AI chat partner (Lucía) prompted with their saved vocabulary. Free use of all features (one story, one flashcard round, one minute with Lucía) is followed by a 7-day trial subscription.
mentions.problem: The builder hit a plateau using Duolingo plus a tutor, and found manually highlighting Kindle words, exporting them to Anki, and feeding progress back to a tutor fiddly and time-consuming, while practicing speaking only once a day wasn't enough.
